# prime-menu

prime-rs: Menu component (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/menu) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-menu) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/menu.md)

Menu — port of `p-menu` from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

A list of commands and links with groups and separators: static or popping up at a target element. The popup menu
is controlled by `MenuRef` (the analog of `menu.toggle($event)` from PrimeNG): it is created in advance, passed to `Menu`
and called from handlers.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_menu::{Menu, MenuItem};

let html = view! {
    <Menu model=vec![MenuItem::new().label("New"), MenuItem::new().label("Search")] />
}
.to_html();
assert!(html.contains("p-menu-item-label") && html.contains("New"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-menu = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["menu"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
